title: 基礎奠定核心單字 (TOEIC 400-600) - 第 10 單元 (3601~4000 字)
description: 多益入門必備單字與基礎情境片語，涵蓋辦公室基本溝通與日常商務。（分單元 10/13）

words.definitionZh: 資源；可用於達成目標的資產或能力。

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of resource.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【資源】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in resource.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【資源】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in resource has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【資源】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【資源】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。
quizzes.strategy: 空格位於 corporate 之後作為名詞主詞/受詞，選入名詞 resource 最切合商務方針。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意名詞單複數與可數/不可數之文法特徵。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「資源」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: Strict compliance with established _____ is mandatory for all personnel operating heavy machinery.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 切實遵守既定的【資源】，對於所有操作重型機具之人員皆屬強制規定。
quizzes.strategy: established 為形容詞，介系詞 with 之後需填入受詞名詞 resource。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意介系詞後受詞之詞性要求與上下文語法結構。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】文法詞性完全符合空格之結構要求。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'resource' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「resource」（【資源】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，resource（資源）之核心涵義與 resource 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

請確保我們部門採取一切必要措施，在日常營運中【資源】既定的企業基準。

To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

quizzes.stemTranslation:

To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries run a meeting before Friday's executive meeting.

examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【召開會議】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

quizzes.stem: All division managers are requested to submit their quarterly expenditure reports _____ .

quizzes.strategy: 分析句末副詞/介系詞片語位置，選入最切合商務作業規範之片語 run a meeting。
